name: CommuteAssistBikeDock

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short hire bike scene. A person on a hire bike needs to return it and asks their assistant where the nearest docking station is. One question, one answer.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City cycling, outdoor urban, street noise, hire bike sounds

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short hire bike scene. The person has been cycling on a hire bike and needs to return it — either the rental is nearly up or they're at their destination. They ask Sigma where the nearest docking station is. Sigma gives the location. Person heads there.

variations.context: On a hire bike — asking Sigma where to return it

setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo hire bike user in an unfamiliar area
setting.background: She's used a hire bike to cross part of the city. Needs to dock it before the time runs out or because she's arrived.
setting.conversation_style: One fast question while cycling. One dock location answer.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma where the nearest bike docking station is
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, where's the nearest Vélib dock?' or 'Sigma, nearest bike docking station?'

scenario_template.note: Sigma: street or landmark + distance. One sentence. Person: 'okay' and cycles there.
